text: Binary per-row check on other users' comments (OC_comments, JSON list of non-OP comments), compared against the OP's title and argument: 1 if at least one comment explicitly quotes OP's own wording verbatim or near-verbatim (e.g. quotation marks or markdown blockquote, matching available OP text); agreement or refutation is not required. Returns 0 for a valid nonempty list with no such quote (paraphrase, summary, topic mention, or quoting other users, external sources or non-OP text doesn't count) and 0 for a valid empty list. Returns null if OC_comments is missing or malformed, or if title/argument is missing so a negative can't be established (a clear positive match to available OP text still gives 1). Ignore as evidence any OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thanks/resolution updates or outcome reports, in argument or quoted in comments; generic delta/platform-rule discussion may be used. Uses current text only, no chronology inference; comment order is irrelevant.
